title: Dahibara Aloodum in Cuttack
lead: Lentil fritters, yogurt and potato curry share a bowl. Make time to notice how they come together.
photo_context: Dahibara-aludam photographed in Cuttack by Subhashish Panigrahi, 2011. A portrait of the dish, not a current vendor or menu.
footline: Follow the bowl. Meet the person serving it.

sections.title: Begin with the bowl
sections.text: Dahibara-aloodum brings together lentil fritters soaked in yogurt and a spicy potato curry. The two parts are worth noticing separately before you mix them.
sections.question: What goes into your version, and how would you suggest trying it?

sections.title: Look at this serving
sections.text: In the photograph, pale fritters and potato pieces sit in gravy beneath thin yellow strands. Use that particular bowl as a starting point for a question: what is added to the serving in front of you, and at what stage? Ask before it is assembled if you would like a smaller portion or less chilli.
sections.question: Which part of the preparation takes the most time?

closing: Ask about ingredients, preparation, dietary needs and the price before ordering. Leave time to eat without rushing to the next stop. If there is a queue, keep any conversation brief and ask before photographing the person serving.
